lang_prompt: 🌐 Choose your language / Escolha seu idioma:
welcome:
Hi, {name}! 👋

Welcome to our store. Use the menu below to buy or check your orders.
no_products: There are no products available right now. Please come back later!
out_of_stock: 😕 Product out of stock. Tap 🔔 Notify me and we'll message you as soon as it's back.
no_payment_methods: No payment method is available right now. Please try again later.
pix_instructions: 📲 Pay with PIX Scan the QR code or use the copy and paste code below: {code} Confirmation is automatic — as soon as the bank confirms, you will receive your product here.
checkout_instructions: 🔐 Tap the button below to pay securely. Confirmation is automatic — you will receive your product here.
balance_paid: ✅ Balance payment approved. Your product will be sent in a moment.
order_still_pending: ⏳ We have not received the payment confirmation for order #{number} yet. As soon as the provider confirms it, you will receive the product automatically.
too_many_pending: You already have pending orders. Complete or cancel one of them before creating another.
insufficient_balance: Insufficient balance. Your balance: {balance}. Product price: {price}.
payment_confirmed: ✅ Payment confirmed! Your order has been processed. Product: {product} Your access: {item} Order: #{number} Thank you for your purchase.
paid_out_of_stock: ✅ Payment for order #{number} confirmed, but the product ran out of stock before delivery. Our team has been notified and will resolve it (delivery or refund) as soon as possible.
help_text: ❓ Help 1. Tap 🛒 Buy and choose a product. 2. Choose a payment method (PIX, card or balance). 3. Pay — confirmation is automatic. 4. The product is delivered here in the chat and saved under 📦 My orders. 5. Questions or problems? Tap 💬 Support. ⚠️ We never deliver before the payment provider confirms the payment.
balance_info: 👛 Your balance: {balance} You can use your balance to buy any product (USD price).
deposit_disabled: Binance Pay deposits are unavailable right now.
deposit_choose_amount: How much would you like to add? (in {asset})
deposit_custom_prompt: Type the amount in {asset} (min. {min}, max. {max}). E.g.: 15
deposit_invalid_amount: Invalid amount. Enter a value between {min} and {max}.
deposit_instructions: 🟡 Binance Pay deposit 1. In the Binance app, open Pay → Send. 2. Send exactly {amount} {asset} to Binance Pay ID: {payId} 3. After sending, tap “I have paid” and send the transfer Order ID. ⚠️ The amount must be exact (including cents) so we can identify your deposit. ⏳ Valid until {expires}.
deposit_open_instructions: 🟡 Add balance via Binance Pay 1. In the Binance app, open Pay → Send. 2. Send any amount in {assets} to Binance Pay ID: {payId} 3. After sending, tap “I have paid” and send the transfer Order ID. ✅ The received amount is detected automatically and credited to your balance (1 USDT = US$ 1.00). ⏳ Send the ID within {hours}h after paying.
deposit_tx_rejected: This transaction cannot be credited. It must be a transfer received by our wallet in one of the accepted assets ({assets}).
deposit_send_tx_prompt: Send the Binance Pay transfer Order ID:
deposit_no_pending: You have no pending deposit. Tap 👛 Balance to start one.
deposit_tx_invalid: Invalid ID. Copy the Order ID shown in the Binance transfer details.
deposit_tx_not_found: We could not find this incoming transaction in our wallet. Check the ID and wait a few minutes if you just sent it.
deposit_tx_used: This transaction has already been used.
deposit_tx_mismatch: The transaction was found but does not match the deposit (amount, asset or time). Expected amount: {amount} {asset}. Contact support if needed.
deposit_too_many_attempts: Too many attempts for this deposit. Please contact support.
deposit_unavailable: We could not reach Binance right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
too_many_requests: ⏱️ Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
generic_error: ⚠️ Something went wrong. Please try again shortly.
payment_error: ⚠️ We could not start the payment right now. Try again or choose another payment method.
unknown_command: I did not understand. Use the menu below 👇
support_choose_order: 📦 Which order is the problem about?
support_no_orders: You have no orders yet. If you have a question before buying, choose “🛍️ Question before buying”.
support_write: ✍️ Type your message. You can also send a screenshot (image).
support_write_order: ✍️ Order #{number}: describe the problem. You can also send a screenshot (image).
support_created: ✅ Ticket #{number} opened! Our team will reply right here. You can keep sending messages to this ticket.
support_open_ticket: 💬 You have ticket #{number} open ({status}). Send a message to continue the conversation or close the ticket.
support_closed: ✅ Ticket #{number} closed. Thank you! If you need anything else, open a new one in 💬 Support.
support_closed_by_team: ✅ Ticket #{number} was closed by our support team. If you need anything, open a new one in 💬 Support.
support_empty: Send a text or an image.
support_too_long: Message too long. Please split it into smaller parts.
notify_me_subscribed: 🔔 Done! We'll let you know when this product is back in stock.
restock_notice: 🔔 {name} is back in stock! Get yours before it runs out.
